purpose: Define machine-readable context metadata for each label so identical source strings used for different semantic purposes remain distinguishable during translation.

topics.name: Localization Label Context
topics.purpose: Define machine-readable context metadata for each label so identical source strings used for different semantic purposes remain distinguishable during translation.

semantics.target_rule: Context includes exact target identity where available.
semantics.role_rule: Button, noun, verb, status, field label, help text and other semantic roles are distinguishable.
semantics.collision_rule: Identical source text in different contexts may use separate label identities.
semantics.translator_rule: Context metadata is available to translation tooling without changing runtime semantics.
semantics.privacy_rule: Context must not embed secrets or unnecessary user data.
semantics.fallback_rule: Missing translation fallback uses explicit language/fallback policy.

invariants.rule: Localized labels are context-bearing presentation resources mapped to stable canonical identities; translation never changes command names, internal identifiers or semantic identity.

hard_gates.condition: same text forced into one label despite incompatible contexts
label context lacks target/role where needed

references.purpose: Context belongs to managed label identities.
